name: github-copilot-remote-chat
description: GitHub Copilot SDK chat client hosted on a remote user-computer-profile. The AgentChat router and persistence stay on the source instance; the CopilotSdkChatClient and its built-in tools run on the remote profile reached over the reverse transport.
instructions: You are a helpful assistant running behind a Phantom.Workspaces remote agent session. The router and persistence live on the source instance; your Copilot CLI process and its built-in shell/filesystem tools run on the remote user-computer-profile named by the resolved trust profile.

tools.description: Open/close panes and tabs and invoke entity shortcuts. Classified as ExecutorTarget.GuiLocal; always runs on the source (initiating) instance.
Read and write workspace entities via the data-access-layer. Classified as ExecutorTarget.GuiLocal; always runs on the source instance.

Access the source-side agent-session that initiated this run. Classified as ExecutorTarget.HostingInstance; when the target session id equals the source session id ExecutorTargetResolver.ForKindWithTargetSession reclassifies it as ExecutorTarget.GuiLocal so it runs locally on the source.
Filesystem MCP built-in. Defaults to ExecutorTarget.AgentExecutor; in a remote-hosted session the agent executor resolves to the remote user-computer-profile so this runs on the remote host.
GitHub Copilot SDK built-in tool policy. The Copilot CLI self-invokes these tools wherever CopilotSdkChatClient runs — the remote profile in this topology.

tools.name: github
tools.description: Optional GitHub MCP server. Defaults to ExecutorTarget.AgentExecutor and runs on the remote host in this topology.

metadata.author: Phantom Workspaces
prerequisites: The remote user-computer-profile is enrolled and reachable via the reverse-tunnel transport.
An llm-trust-profile exists whose HostingWorkspacesClientInstances contains the remote profile's client-instance id (see Phantom.Workspaces.Llm.Core/Trust/TrustProfile.cs).
GITHUB_TOKEN with Copilot access is available on the remote host, or the remote user is signed in to the Copilot CLI.

parameters.note: When wrapped as an agent-manifest, declare these two parameters on the manifest (not on the AgentDefinition itself). The Launchpad UI collects values and AgentDefinitionParameterSubstitutor substitutes them into model.options.additionalProperties.

properties.name: working-directory
properties.description: Working directory the Copilot CLI uses on the remote host.

properties.name: trust-profile
properties.description: Name of an llm-trust-profile whose HostingWorkspacesClientInstances lists the remote user-computer-profile client-instance id.
